meta.title: My Flights
meta.description: View and manage your paragliding flights. Track your progress, analyze flight data, and review detailed statistics for each flight.

header.title: Flights log
header.subtitleCounts: {fetched} of {total, plural, one {# flight} other {# flights}} · sorted by {sort}.

hint.qualityVsAvg: How this flight's quality compares to your lifetime median.
hint.qualityDeviation: Standard deviation of the quality scores of the thermals within this flight. Lower = more consistent climbs.
hint.routeEfficiency: Ratio of scoring distance to total track distance. More meaningful for cross-country flights.
hint.hasVectorVario: Flights whose file carries Vector Vario data: airspeed, attitude, measured wind. Recorded by the Vector itself or by an app paired with it.
hint.hasHeartRate: Flights whose file carries your heart rate from a chest strap. Only you can see it.

columns.gpsCorruptionHint: IGC file contains GPS corruption. Scored distance and track length may be unreliable.

empty.rightsBody: Under <access>GDPR Article 15</access> (right of access) and <portability>Article 20</portability> (right to data portability), you can request any platform (XContest, DHV-XC, Syride, or others) to provide a copy of your personal data, including your flight tracks.

sharedLink.description: Anyone with this link can view this flight without signing in.

sharedLinkConfirm.title: Create Shared Link?
sharedLinkConfirm.intro: You're about to create a secret link that allows anyone with the URL to view this flight without signing in.
sharedLinkConfirm.noticeBody: While the URL contains a hard-to-guess identifier, it's not impossible to discover. Anyone who obtains the link can view this flight. Only share with people you trust.
sharedLinkConfirm.revoke: You can remove the shared link at any time to revoke access.

dates.triggerAria: Fix flights dates - Try to fix your instrument's wrong date encoding
dates.title: Fix Date Encoding Issue
dates.description: This will swap day and year values for {count, plural, one {# flight} other {# flights}}
dates.explanation: The IGC standard requires dates in DDMMYY format. Some instruments incorrectly produce YYMMDD format. This operation swaps day and year values.
dates.warning: Warning: Only use this if your instrument produces wrong date formats. Incorrect use will corrupt your timeline. Learn more
